info.title: Restaurant Operations Management System (ROMS) API
info.description:
Enterprise RESTful API Specification for Restaurant Operations Management System (Gia Vị Việt F&B).

### Architecture Standards:
- **Base Protocol**: HTTPS + RESTful JSON
- **Authentication**: Dual-Strategy (Manager JWT Bearer + Waitstaff Quick PIN Session)
- **Data Integrity**: Price Snapshot Pattern for orders & Financial Immutability for Invoices
- **Realtime Channel**: Bi-directional SignalR WebSocket Hub at `/hubs/restaurant`

post.summary: Dispatch Order Items to Kitchen (Gửi Bếp & Gọi Thêm Món)
post.description:
Dispatches a batch of dishes to Kitchen KDS.
- Supports first-round ordering and subsequent add-on batches (`isAddon: true`).
- Uses Price Snapshot Pattern to freeze `unit_price` at dispatch moment.
- Triggers SignalR `ReceiveNewTicket` audio alert at target kitchen station.

delete.description:
- If item status is `QUEUED`: Automatically voids item.
- If item status is `COOKING`: Rejects with 422 Unprocessable Entity, requiring Manager Approval.
